gaps: P0: no candidates. P5: no candidates. P4 general view (#17, Passos 1885) is pale, folded and small; not used.
notes: P1: #1 (Rijksmuseum, dated 1572) shows the view on its own with a tall added sky and no cartouche, which looks like a later reissue of the plate, so the 1582 colored copy was used. P2 view #9 copies the Braun and Hogenberg view, so it adds little new. P4 alternative: San Pablo church photochrom (#14), more famous but an upright picture that loses its towers in a wide crop. P6 photos are all weak; #18 (2008 aerial of the Royal Palace) is a single building.
